items.title: 73rd and 74th Amendments: the foundation of local self-government
items.summary: The 73rd Amendment gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions, and the 74th did the same for urban local bodies. Both added a schedule listing the functions that states may devolve to these bodies.
keyFacts: 73rd Amendment (1992) inserted Part IX on Panchayats
Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects for Panchayats
74th Amendment inserted Part IXA on Municipalities
Twelfth Schedule lists 18 subjects for Municipalities

items.title: Public Accounts Committee: role and convention
items.summary: The Public Accounts Committee examines the Comptroller and Auditor General's audit reports on government expenditure. By long convention, its chairperson is drawn from the Opposition.
keyFacts: Examines CAG audit reports on government accounts
By convention, chaired by a member of the Opposition

source.name: Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha committee information

items.title: RBI's Monetary Policy Committee and the repo rate
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India sets its main policy rate through a Monetary Policy Committee. The repo rate is the benchmark rate at which the RBI lends to commercial banks.
keyFacts: MPC has six members; the RBI Governor chairs it
Repo rate is the benchmark policy rate

questions.question: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act primarily relates to which institutions?
questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment (1992) gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions. The 74th Amendment covers urban local bodies.

questions.question: How many subjects are listed in the Eleventh Schedule of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects for Panchayats. The Twelfth Schedule lists 18 subjects for Municipalities, so 18 is a common distractor.

questions.question: By long convention, who chairs the Public Accounts Committee?
options: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.explanation: By convention the PAC is chaired by a member of the Opposition. The CAG audits government accounts and assists the committee but does not chair it.

questions.question: How many members does the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee have?
questions.explanation: The MPC has six members, including the RBI Governor, who chairs it.
